description: Vendor, OEM, peripheral and anti-cheat names that must not appear in product logic (HC-12, acceptance #17). The lint scans src/ and tools/ outside allowlisted vendor-adapter assemblies. Matches are whole words, case-insensitive, comments ignored.

entries.displayName: GPU and CPU vendors and their API names
entries.notes: Vendor APIs belong in allowlisted adapter assemblies only.
OEM and peripheral behaviour must come from data catalogs, not code.
Anti-cheat knowledge lives in catalogs/anticheat.json and catalogs/protected_titles.json.
